design_condition: The low volume sits between the street and stream, bridges the plain and hillside levels through entrances on both sides, and expands the floodplain landscape with terraces, arcades, and a covered break space.

positive.statement: The elongated schoolhouse clearly reads as part of the Reppisch stream landscape.

position.rationale: Elongated building footprint is clearly visible diagonally across the top view and consistently in all elevations.

positive.statement: The small offset pleasantly breaks the building body and marks the entrances on both sides.

position.target: small offset and entrances on both sides
position.rationale: Offset is visible near the central kink in the elongated footprint, with entrances constrained to opposite sides.

positive.statement: The two levels of the plot and the grown neighborhood structure are coherently connected.

position.rationale: Plot-level connection is approximated across the lower and upper portions of the terraced building setting.

positive.statement: The lower floor is lifted because of flood risk and establishes an architectural reference to the site condition.

position.rationale: Lower storey is visibly separated from the upper volume in elevation and sits near the base datum.

positive.statement: Terraces, arcades, and a covered break space cleverly expand the outdoor area.

position.target: terraces, arcades, and covered break space
position.rationale: Outdoor extensions are approximated along the lower side of the footprint where stepped and recessed edges appear.

positive.statement: The circulation and escape concept leaves the access zones free for use as extended learning areas.

position.target: access zones and extended learning areas
position.rationale: Access and learning spill-out zones are estimated beside the wider southwest portion of the building footprint.

positive.statement: The clear modular wooden structure is consistently developed and implemented architecturally and constructively.

position.rationale: Regular sampled lines suggest a repeated structural system, but material and modular joints are not distinguishable.

positive.statement: The escape balconies provide simple summer shading while enabling transparency and networking with the surrounding area.

position.rationale: Facade projections are approximated along the southeast-facing edge and upper level of the sampled volume.

positive.statement: The project offers an interesting and carefully developed contribution to a sustainable school building.

position.rationale: Comment concerns the complete low-rise school volume, anchored to its visible elongated footprint and two-level envelope.
